source_evidence: Exact player 'yes' accepts the immediately preceding recommendation to redo ONLY the still-unengaged Day337 encounter selection and improve the selection pool. Preserve D335 provisioning, all D336 travel/rest, actual D337 occurrence28/type57/severity89, Long Rest and resources, time11:30, route24/30mi, cap1/1; no encounter replay, extra frequency check or difficulty downgrade. Supersede the eight-gnoll roster/sighting only; its earlier genuine identity roll13/79 remains auditable, not current. New pre-draw table37 group/activity/composition candidates, weighted82, based on full source index @53a02f9c87d250ce3a89bd6b9af7038839095b52, seed catalogue @cc07d27238d415112b8f8fa52dafc700d81438d6 and scoped source-metadata review of VGM, MTF, BGG, GGR, MOT, WBtW, ERLW, IDRotF, FTD, PotA, SKT, EGW, DSotDQ, JttRC, MPMM, VRGR, CM, TftYP, GoS, WDMM, ToA, BGDIA, CRCotN and OotA. Not exhaustive ingestion/verification of every monster in the index; candidate table estimates are preselection, only selected composition mechanically activated. Ecology: temperate western Ossent wooded hills and sheltered rocky cuts, eligible hostile organized predators/armed groups, plausible inherited/transplanted communities, no imported named setting factions, fresh portal or automatic regional settlement. Reduce recent gnoll and Dolgaunt-family weights to1, other recent aberrants downweighted, keep repeats possible. Actual visible Python secrets batch6cb4ca9704baa988f233fa74c34f42da d82=30 maps row11 range30–31 DERRO prospecting warband, three Derro Savants and four Derro, hostile extraction from shaded hillside mine entrance. Full selected MTF pp158–159 records read @acfdc49a791dda52bbc4907e66aae370406f6f94, PHB spells read @18629ea6f73589442ca0ccade54105fb581e9ec8. CR3x3 (700XP each)+CR1/4x4 (50XP each)=2300 base×2.5=5750 adjusted, Deadly under three level7 thresholds; actual threat especially high due to multiple spellcasters and group clustered in coach. No concealed extra forces or legendary actions. Derro (Small humanoid, AC13 HP13 speed30 STR10 DEX14 CON12 INT11 WIS5 CHA9, Stealth+4 passive7 darkvision120, Dwarvish/Undercommon, Magic Resistance adv against spells and magical effects, Sunlight Sensitivity disadvantage attack rolls/sight Perception in sunlight, Hooked Spear +2 reach5 1d6 piercing OR choose no damage and prone Medium/smaller, light crossbow+4 80/320 1d8+2). Savant (Small humanoid AC13 HP36 speed30 STR9 DEX14 CON12 INT11 WIS5 CHA14, Stealth+4 passive7 darkvision120, same languages/traits, staff+1 reach5 1d6-1; 5th-level CHA caster DC12 +4, cantrips Acid Splash/Mage Hand/Message/Prestidigitation/Ray of Frost; L1 4 Burning Hands/Chromatic Orb/Sleep, L2 3 Invisibility/Spider Climb, L3 2 Lightning Bolt EACH, no precasts. Genuine normal material components assumed for listed monster casting via ordinary spell component supplies, no special diamond added; Chromatic Orb only if required 50gp diamond actually established, otherwise unavailable. No campaign banned spells. Lightning Bolt 100ft×5ft Dex12 8d6 half on success, cannot through total cover; sunlight does not impose disadvantage on save-based spells. Magic Resistance only actual applicable saves, no damage resistance. Spell details verified PHB.) New local situation fixed before player action: distinct narrow shaded stone cut with small natural fissure/rough excavation at east side of road, about6 rough miles short of Silverward, finite underground prospecting group working stones and tools, not new estate, ancient seat, Vaishnavi tie, confirmed valuable ore, rescue hook or larger faction. They have armed guards and sorcerers, protect their extraction and seek supplies/pack cargo, hostile to passing group when sighted; two guards level crossbows, one savant shouts harsh command; no attack, spell, automatic surrender or initiative. Road direction +y, 15ft width, coach center(0,0) Mara reins, four horses ahead; V/Cirren/Fenar aboard, no dismount. Road clear south and north; D1(35,45) and D2(35,65) z0 near rock barriers half cover from coach, D3(55,45) and D4(55,65) z+5, S1(65,60) and S2(75,65) z+10 on shaded shelf, S3(70,80) z+10 at fissure mouth, half cover from low rocks for S1/S3, S2 exposed from road. Nearest~55–60ft, farthest~105–110ft; off-road rocky slope/scrub difficult terrain, not road; actual deep rock shade where foes stand, open direct daylight track; light/cover adjust by actual movement. Both sides visibly aware, no surprise, no assumed hidden foes. Threat may be avoided or confronted; no auto-attack or forced choice. No V resource/custody/time change, D337 daily supply charge still pending, same exact scene timing. Fixed replacement only; source/owner sync pending.
